title: Juicy Korean Sujebi Noodles
description: Umami-rich, tender, and crowd-pleasing Korean noodles featuring turmeric and long-fermentation-dough. A low-carb-friendly twist on traditional sujebi.

ingredients.name: Turmeric long-fermentation dough (homemade or store-bought)
ingredients.notes: homemade dough recipe: combine 1 cup warm water, 2 tsp sugar, 1 tsp active dry yeast, 3 cups all-purpose flour, and 1 tsp salt; let ferment for 24 hours

instructions: Knead the turmeric long-fermentation dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin sheet.
Cut the dough sheet into 1-inch wide noodles.
Heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Korean chili flakes and gochujang to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the noodles to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes or until slightly tender.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the noodles are fully cooked.
Stir in the fish sauce (if using) and chopped green onions.
Serve the sujebi noodles hot, garnished with toasted sesame seeds (if desired).
